other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian national.
Applicant must be registered for a full‑time Ph.D. programme in a recognised Indian institution/university in STEM (including Medicine, Pharma, Agriculture) disciplines.
Part‑time and sponsored Ph.D. students are not eligible.
Students who have already submitted their thesis for award are ineligible.
Selected fellows must not draw their regular research fellowship in India while undertaking the overseas fellowship.
Supervisors’ exchange visits must occur during the applicant’s Ph.D. tenure, with each supervisor staying abroad for at least two weeks and not more than 30 days.
The overseas institution must have a signed MoU/Agreement with SERB.
Purdue University faculty may support only one OVDF application per call.
benefits_summary: Selected fellows receive a US$2,000 monthly stipend, a one‑time contingency allowance of ₹60,000, round‑trip economy airfare, and additional travel, per‑diem, and accommodation allowances for supervisor visits.
